row.evidence: Manhattan's developer docs say "For identity provisioning and active directory integration, ActivePlatform™ supports a variety of authentication modes with Open ID and SAML", with Just-In-Time user creation over SAML 2.0 and OIDC; no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: New row; slug 'manhattan' taken to mean Manhattan Associates' Manhattan Active platform (WMS, TMS, OMS, POS). No public pricing: manh.com/pricing redirects to the home page and the site only offers 'Request a Demo'. Identity runs through Access Management 2.0 (Keycloak-based): customer IdPs (Entra ID, ADFS, Okta, Ping and others) connect over SAML 2.0 or OIDC, and users are created and updated just-in-time on sign-in. Deleting a JIT user needs Manhattan Operations to clean up. The public developer portal (full sitemap read) never mentions SCIM. The cross-solution API reference (api.developer.manh.com) returns 401 without a customer login, so status none rests on the public identity docs; recheck if a SCIM endpoint appears there. Manhattan is not in the Okta catalogue under the slugs tried; Okta and Entra are custom SAML/OIDC apps.

plans.name: Manhattan Active (quote-only)
plans.price_text: No public pricing; Request a Demo

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented on developer.manh.com. Provisioning is described only as SAML 2.0 / OIDC just-in-time user creation in Access Management 2.0.

user_api.notes: The cross-solution API reference sits behind a login (401). The public portal shows one Access Management 2.0 user endpoint (clear a user's IdP association); no public user CRUD endpoints were found.

endpoints.purpose: Clear a user's federated IdP association (Access Management 2.0)

okta.notes: Manhattan documents a customer-built Okta SAML/OIDC app with optional JIT; no Okta catalogue app found.

entra.notes: Customer-built Entra SAML/OIDC app with optional JIT; no Entra gallery app found.

fallbacks.notes: JIT creates and updates users in the Organization Database; JIT users cannot simply be deleted and recreated (Manhattan Operations cleanup). Robot (API) users are native-only.

citations.quote: Previously, the ActivePlatform™ supported Just In Time (JIT) user provisioning exclusively for the SAML 2.0 protocol. With Access Management 2.0, JIT support has been extended to include the OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocol as well.

citations.title: Managing IdPs | Developer

citations.title: Managing IdPs | Developer

citations.title: Security | Developer
citations.quote: For identity provisioning and active directory integration, ActivePlatform™ supports a variety of authentication modes with Open ID and SAML:

citations.title: Security | Developer
citations.quote: External Authentication Mode with SAML is a login configuration where the user is exclusively authenticated via an external Identity Provider using SAML as the identity protocol. In this mode, all users are maintained by the external Identity Provider.

citations.title: Security | Developer
citations.quote: All Robot users are exclusively maintained by Native Authentication and cannot be maintained by an external Identity Provider.

citations.title: Configure login modes | Developer
citations.quote: Integration with the IDPs listed below has been tested and supported: Microsoft Entra ID: Open ID & SAML ADFS: Open ID & SAML Okta: Open ID & SAML

citations.title: Access Management 2.0 FAQ | Developer

citations.title: Access Management 2.0 FAQ | Developer
